signature.composition: short buffer at upper left with curved arrow ending beside I16 lower right

prompt: One square flat icon on white for reading a signed 16 bit value from a local buffer. At upper left show a small navy buffer rectangle. From it a bold orange curved arrow bends downward and points to the RIGHT, ending above a very large I16 at bottom. Use exact black characters capital I, digit 1, digit 6; capital I has broad top and bottom bars and a clearly visible gap separates each character. Arrowhead must be unmistakable at 30x18 and letters legible. Keep everything within the central 70 percent of canvas. No other writing or shadows.
concept_summary: Buffer curved output to signed value
